XY series · XY

XY

Released February 5, 2014 · 146 cards

Expanded

XY is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on February 5, 2014. It has 146 cards. It includes 120 Pokémon, 15 Trainer and 11 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

29 illustrators worked on XY. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (54), Ryo Ueda (6), Kagemaru Himeno (5), Kanako Eo (5), Eske Yoshinob (4), kawayoo (4), Kouki Saitou (4), Midori Harada (4).
